overview: 1941 telegram clarifies Japan's Kwantung lease grants administrative authority, not territorial incorporation, per Dairen's consul, filed at 894C.5151/8.

subfiles.title: List of Papers entry on the status of the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: An archival listing summarizes an April 4, 1941 telegram clarifying the United States position on Japanese authority and sovereignty in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: Records an April 1941 telegram: Japan's lease gives Kwantung administrative authority, not territorial incorporation per the U.S., filed at 894C.5151/8.

interest: Tracks U.S. distinction between Kwantung administration and sovereignty.
